welcome.title: Start here
welcome.body:
This is your first note. Change it or delete it as you like.

## Everyday things

- Press ⌘K for the launcher: find things, run commands.
- Press ⌘N to add something, or ⌥⌘N anywhere to note a line in the inbox.
- Type [[ to link to another item, / to insert headings, lists and diagrams.
- The lock beside the title sets the privacy level.

## Your data

Everything is encrypted in the folder you chose. Only your master password or recovery code opens it. Import and export are under Library in Settings.

lib.join.about: Choose where your other computer syncs to. The library downloads here, then opens with its master password.
sync.about: Sync with your other computers. Files are encrypted before they leave this computer, so the storage cannot read them; it sees only how many there are, their sizes and times.
sync.auto: While the library is open, it syncs every 5 minutes.
sync.lost: Most files are missing from the sync storage. It may be the wrong place, or it was wiped. Nothing was changed.
sync.insecure: The address must use https, unless the server is on this computer
sync.vaultNote: The password vault syncs too, encrypted the same way, and opens with its own password.
scheduled.title: Scheduled tasks
scheduled.about: While the app is open, AI carries out what you wrote in the body on schedule. The result lands in the inbox, marked as AI's and to be checked. It sees only normal content. With the dedicated browser on, anything it would send asks you first; if nobody answers, it waits here until you run the task again.
